subject.title: feat: advertise realtime voice provider voices in talk.catalog

question: Should realtime providers expose a flat provider-wide voice list now, or should voice discovery become model-aware or dynamic before expanding the public Plugin SDK?
rationale: Tests establish implementation behavior, but they cannot determine the intended long-term external plugin contract, and the current OpenAI producer demonstrates the limitation of universal flat lists.

options.title: Accept and enforce the flat contract
options.body: Keep the optional field, require every producer to advertise only the intersection accepted by all supported models, and omit it when no universal set exists.

options.title: Design model-aware discovery first
options.body: Pause the SDK addition and define per-model or dynamically resolved voice metadata before exposing a public field.

recommendation.title: Accept and enforce the flat contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional field, require every producer to advertise only the intersection accepted by all supported models, and omit it when no universal set exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available merged-history connection to the affected realtime provider architecture, though broader Plugin SDK ownership may be shared.
